channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jose Calderon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jose Calderon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Meleek Thomas on Jose Calderon
item.description:
Meleek Thomas:

“Jose Calderon, I was very familiar with his game and now to be in the same organization as him is pretty special. I told him today that I am very appreciative for him having me here specifically and having my teammates here and all of us as one organization just because it takes a lot to infiltrate like a whole camp like this in a different country. You have to price everything out. You have to know everybody stands. So for him to orchestrate that and get that all together with the organization is big time in my opinion.”

Meleek Thomas on Jose Calderon, Oct 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Andre Drummond, Jose Calderon, LeBron James
item.description:
Lue on LeBron:

“We can't run him into the ground. I'm definitely not putting him on Drummond. I'll put Calderon on him before I do that”

Tyronn Lue on Andre Drummond, Jose Calderon, LeBron James, Mar 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @RickNoland.

item.title: Koby Altman on Derrick Rose, Jose Calderon, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Koby Altman on plan w/o Isaiah Thomas:

“We're very fortunate to have signed Derrick Roseand we also have Jose Calderon.”

Koby Altman on Derrick Rose, Jose Calderon, Isaiah Thomas, Sep 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.
